title: Automations: a scheduled run, a catch-up after sleep, and a failure with its log, live in the app

steps.title: Launch
New workspace automations
Terminal: three automations made with the CLI, the runner started in the background
cmux: clear; cmux automation create 'Every minute' --command 'echo checked disk' --every 1m >/dev/null && cmux automation create 'Nightly build' --command 'echo building; echo "error: 2 tests failed" >&2; exit 3' --manual >/dev/null && cmux automation create 'Morning brief' --prompt 'Summarize my open pull requests' --weekdays 09:00 >/dev/null && cmux automation list; cmux automation runner >"$TMPDIR/automation-runner.log" 2>&1 & sleep 2; cmux automation runner status

steps.title: Automations page: three automations, the runner on, next runs, no runs yet
Wait for the first scheduled minute (1/3)
Wait for the first scheduled minute (2/3)
Wait for the first scheduled minute (3/3)
The runner fired Every minute at its scheduled minute; its run succeeded and its log shows
Stop the runner (the Mac goes to sleep)
cmux: kill %1; wait; cmux automation runner status

steps.title: Runner stopped: the page says automations are off on this Mac, with Turn On
Asleep (1/6)
Asleep (2/6)
Asleep (3/6)
Asleep (4/6)
Asleep (5/6)
Asleep (6/6)
Start the runner again (the Mac wakes)
cmux: cmux automation runner >"$TMPDIR/automation-runner.log" 2>&1 & sleep 2; cmux automation history 'Every minute'

steps.title: After the gap: one late catch-up run, the missed minutes skipped with their reason
Run Nightly build now; it fails
cmux: clear; cmux automation run 'Nightly build' --wait; cmux automation history 'Nightly build'
